claims: National Cheesesteak Day is celebrated annually on March 24.
A cheesesteak is made with thinly sliced beef, melted cheese, and onions on a hoagie roll.
Pat Olivieri was a hot dog vendor in the 1930s.
Pat Olivieri opened Pat's King of Steaks.
The origin of the cheesesteak is often attributed to Pat Olivieri.
In cheesesteak orders, "wit or witout" refers to with or without onions.
Cheesesteak cheese preferences include whiz, provolone, or American.
In 2026, Philadelphia International Airport set a new Guinness World Record for the "Longest Line of Cheesesteaks".
